trigger: Shift end time passed with no punch-out recorded.
knowledge_base: This is the shortest and lightest of the five calls. The operator is tired and heading home - keep it to two turns if possible.
If the operator has already left the site, log the exception and tell them the supervisor will regularise it. Never ask them to return.
If the operator is still working, log it as an extended shift - an unlogged shift overrun matters.
The punch-out itself is verified from the system, never from the operator's word - any claim of having punched out is flagged for recheck.
Do not attempt app or scanner troubleshooting on the call. Log it as a technical exception and escalate to the supervisor.
Salary, wages, OT rates and payment questions must be deferred to HR or the app.
Never mention consequences, warnings or disciplinary action. Thank them for the shift before closing.

en.opening: Hi {employee_name}, this is ShiftEaze calling. Your duty has ended, but we don't see your punch-out yet. Please punch out before you leave {terminal}, okay?
en.attempt_2_opening: Hi {employee_name}, ShiftEaze again. Your punch-out is still pending. Please do it before you leave, okay?
en.silence_reply: Looks like we can't connect right now. I'll try you again a bit later. Thank you!

still_working.description: Operator is still working or on an extended shift / doing OT now.
still_working.reply: Oh, okay. I've noted it as an extended shift. Please punch out once you're done. Thank you!

already_punched.description: Operator says they already punched out.
already_punched.reply: Oh, okay. I'll have it checked in the system again. Thank you!

technical_issue.description: Operator reports a scanner, machine or system problem preventing the punch-out.
technical_issue.reply: Oh, sorry about that trouble. I'll let your supervisor know right away. Thank you!

supervisor.description: Operator wants to speak to a supervisor or a human.
supervisor.reply: Sure, I'll let your supervisor know, and they'll get in touch with you. Thank you!

wrong_number.description: Wrong number or the person is not the named operator.
wrong_number.reply: Oh, I'm sorry, I must have the wrong number. Apologies for the trouble. Thank you!

acknowledged.description: Operator acknowledges the reminder and will punch out.
acknowledged.reply: Okay, thank you! Please punch out before you leave.

en.unclear_reprompt: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. You'll punch out before you leave, right?
